questions.question: Every ability of Gon Freecss
questions.subject: Gon Freecss
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Closed set drawn from the Abilities & Powers section of Gon's page, which documents six named abilities. Broader than hxh-set-03: beyond Jajanken and its three forms it adds Round 2 (Aiko de, a double-coat that lets Gon fire two Jajanken attacks back to back -- the page flags that it is unclear whether it is a Nen ability or a Jajanken loophole) and Limitation Transformation, the infobox's explicitly non-canonical/unofficial descriptive name for Gon's self-imposed power contract. Rock, Paper and Scissors are the three forms of Jajanken rather than separate abilities, which is why all four are listed (the same treatment hxh-set-03 uses). Generic natural-ability descriptors (enhanced senses, fishing prowess) are not named abilities and are excluded.

questions.question: Every ability of Killua Zoldyck
questions.subject: Killua Zoldyck
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Closed set drawn from the Abilities & Powers section of Killua's page. Broader than hxh-set-01 (the Nen abilities only): this also includes the three named assassination arts the page documents -- The Snake Awakens (Jakatsu), Silent Gaits (Anpo) and Rhythm Echo (Shikyoku). Godspeed is the umbrella Hatsu whose two core functions are Whirlwind and Speed of Lightning, so all three are listed, matching how hxh-set-01 treats the pair. The page's own romanisations are used as aliases. Generic physical descriptors (preternatural senses, poison immunity, lightning resistance) are not named abilities and are excluded. Bank audit 2026-08-14: added 1 item(s) the wiki documents and the bank omitted: Claws. Each verified against the cited page's raw wikitext.

questions.question: Every ability of Kurapika
questions.subject: Kurapika
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Closed set drawn from the Nen section of Kurapika's page. Broader than hxh-set-02: beyond the six current core abilities it adds Stealth Dolphin (the index-finger dolphin construct that loads and transfers stolen abilities) and, under the page's 'Former Stolen Abilities' subsection, the three abilities Kurapika stole and returned to their owners -- Little Eye (lit. 'Rear Window'), Air Blow (lit. 'Empty Air Fist') and Erigeron (lit. 'Bulb'). The former ones are kept because the page documents them as part of his ability set; their former status is recorded here so a later reader is not misled. Judgment Chain's blade, the Stake of Retribution, is a named component of Judgment Chain rather than a separate ability and is not listed separately.

questions.question: Every ability of Leorio Paradinight
questions.subject: Leorio Paradinight
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Closed set of one. Leorio's page documents exactly one named ability: Remote Punch, an Emission technique that strikes through a wormhole-like circle, which the page flags as a non-canonical/unofficial descriptive name (no Japanese name is given). A single-item closed set is a precision probe -- a script asking for Leorio's abilities should be told about Remote Punch and nothing else. Generic descriptors (preternatural perception, medical knowledge) are not named abilities and are excluded. No other question in this file has Leorio as its subject.

questions.question: Every ability of Hisoka Morow
questions.subject: Hisoka Morow
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Closed set of two. Hisoka's page documents exactly two named abilities -- Bungee Gum and Texture Surprise -- so the answer is intentionally the same set as hxh-set-05 rather than a copy: there is nothing more on the page to add, and this note exists so a later reader does not flag one as a duplicate of the other. The difference is the question's reach: this one asks for the character's complete ability set the way a script would, where hxh-set-05 is the original Nen-ability baseline. General Nen techniques Hisoka employs (Shu, In, Ren, Gyo) are excluded on the same grounds as Meruem's retired En: they are general techniques, not abilities of his.
